brief.title: Total the month's program records by measure
brief.plain_summary: Total the month's program records by measure with the read-only tool, compare each measure with its target and with last month, and keep every missing count as unknown.
brief.outcome: A monthly results table with percent of target and change from last month, and every missing count kept null.

program_records.description: Pin of a noun holding the month's program records by measure and site, with no participant names or details.

targets.description: Pin of a noun holding the month's target for each measure.

last_month.description: Pin of last month's results table, when there is one.

month_start.description: First day of the month being reported, such as 2026-10-01.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

outcome_meanings.month_totaled: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.
outcome_meanings.unknown: The question could not be answered with the permitted inputs. List what is missing and what would resolve it.
outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: The output validates against template.monthly-results's schema.
Every percent_of_target equals counted divided by target times 100, rounded to one decimal place, and every change equals counted minus last_month.
Every measure without a count has counted, percent_of_target and change null and appears in missing.
The output holds no names, phone numbers, email addresses, street addresses or case details.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Total the month's records per measure with the pinned read-only tool.
Compute percent of target only when both the target and the count are known, rounded to one decimal place.
Compute the change from last month only when both months have a count.
Keep a missing count as null, along with its percent and change, and name the site it is missing from.
Mark every measure below 90 percent of its target for the executive director.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
